raised_by_this_lane_owned_elsewhere.issue: This lane makes the catalog upgrade possible; nothing makes it happen. TenantConfigSeeder (backend/app/src/lib.rs:2847) has exactly ONE call site - the tenant-onboarding handler at backend/crates/platform/platform-rest/src/lib.rs:602, for a brand-new organization. There is no re-seed route, no startup reconcile, and no migration that calls the installer. After L-X7 bumps BUILTIN_CATALOG_VERSION, tenants onboarded before the deploy stay at 27 types forever: no deal type, no DL- resolution, an absent CRM ontology surface.
raised_by_this_lane_owned_elsewhere.required: An existing-tenant upgrade trigger at the ordinary bar - mnt_ontology_cmd credentials, scope_org per tenant, deny-by-default authz, an audit row, and a test against a tenant seeded at the OLDER version. The installer is already idempotent, so the trigger needs no guard rails of its own. See report section 6.1.
raised_by_this_lane_owned_elsewhere.status: OPEN - named, not fixed. Out of this lane's scope (backend/app/** and the platform router are not its roots) and not constructible here, since there is no new catalog version to upgrade to until L-X7 ships one.

raised_by_this_lane_owned_elsewhere.severity: hardening recommendation, narrow; NOT a regression
raised_by_this_lane_owned_elsewhere.issue: The two audit actions 0211 adds (ontology.builtin_catalog.install / .upgrade) are not in the protected array of ontology_api.protected_audit_writer_guard (0165:297), while their per-type sibling ontology.object_type.builtin_install - emitted by the same function in the same transaction - is. mnt_rt holds INSERT on audit_events (0031:85), so it can write a row claiming a tenant was upgraded to a version and digest it never received. An auditor reading the chain cannot tell the two classes apart.
raised_by_this_lane_owned_elsewhere.not_a_regression_because: Before 0211 the marker append was audited by nothing at all, so 0211 strictly adds evidence. Every audit action in the repository outside those four names (and 0166's leave set) is equally forgeable by mnt_rt.
raised_by_this_lane_owned_elsewhere.not_fixed_here_because: 0211 is already merged on the spine; editing it in place would change an applied migration's sqlx checksum for anyone who has run it. backend/crates/platform/db/migrations/** is a shared collision root and this lane may not self-assign a follow-up slot.
raised_by_this_lane_owned_elsewhere.proposed_fix: One new integrator-assigned slot: a second BEFORE INSERT trigger on audit_events that rejects those two actions unless ontology_api.invoker_role() = 'mnt_ontology_cmd', mirroring the existing guard's SECURITY DEFINER / mnt_ontology_writer shape. About 15 lines; it does not restate the 60-line guard, so the two cannot drift.
raised_by_this_lane_owned_elsewhere.status: OPEN - integrator to schedule or decline. See report section 5.7.
